description: GPU-only browser Debug resource baseline: three sequential repetitions, native X11/EGL on isolated hardware-backed Weston/Xwayland; existing CPU/RSS/metadata/import metrics, not GPU timing or memory.

metadata.source_state: Production GPU renderer at source_revision; benchmark-only harness/dev-shell changes recorded separately.

display.isolation: Private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and separate X11 display; no desktop input injection.

caveats: CPU and GPU are shared with the live desktop; no exclusive-device or fixed-clock control.
CPU and RSS cover the helper or Pico process tree, excluding Weston, Xwayland, and the Python benchmark.
Frame bytes are metadata payload only, excluding event headers, ancillary FDs/fences, and release-ack command records.
RSS is summed resident memory, not unique memory or GPU memory.
Import timing is host API wall time, not GPU completion or presentation latency.
